_note: Defaults for a landscaping / lawn care business. Design-build and recurring maintenance are two different buyers — the service list covers both.

process.title: Walk the site
process.text: We look at aspect, drainage, soil and access, and talk through how you actually want to use the space.

process.title: Plan and price
process.text: A drawn plan and an itemised price, so you can phase the work if the whole thing is too much at once.

process.title: Build and maintain
process.text: Installed to the plan, then kept up on a schedule if you want us to.

faqs.q: Do you do one-off jobs or only contracts?
faqs.a: Both. Design-build projects and one-off cleanups sit alongside the scheduled maintenance rounds.

faqs.q: When is the best time to plant?
faqs.a: For most regions, autumn and early spring — roots establish before the plant is asked to carry summer heat. We will tell you if waiting a season gets you a better result.

faqs.q: How much does a patio cost?
faqs.a: It comes down to square footage, material and how much excavation and base work the ground needs. The base is the part that decides whether it is still flat in five years, and it is the part cheap quotes leave out.

faqs.q: Do you offer maintenance after the build?
faqs.a: PLACEHOLDER — confirm whether the client offers ongoing maintenance and on what schedule.

faqs.q: Can you work with my HOA?
faqs.a: Yes. Where a submission is needed we will put together the plan and plant list in the format the board expects.
